notes.title: Added difficulties
notes.notes: Added 3 difficulties, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Easy increases HP when leveling up, increase amount of XP, and increase amount of given damage. Normal is the same. Hard decreases hp, xp, and damage given.

notes.title: Update for 5/26/24
notes.notes:
Update 5/26/24
- Flying will not cause damage from fire or spikes
- Removed a few abilities
- Added new abilities ( Time Slip and Levitate)
- Added shaders to floor tiles so other objects will stand out.

notes.title: Conqueror of Time is Released!
notes.notes:
Conqueror of Time is now Released!

Thank you to everyone who will purchase and play this game. I know you will enjoy the game. I would like to thank everyone who supported me during this journey. Publishing my first game is success in itself. I have been programming for 30 years as a hobby and never thought I would be selling a game on Steam. I hope to continue creating more games for people to enjoy.

notes.title: Conqueror of Time
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XYywP9sMu0Y;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Conqueror Of Time is a traditional dungeon crawl rogue game with a time travel theme. Choose a character from different time periods and fight your way through dungeons using various items from different times and spaces. Use time travel abilities to fight alongside your past or future self.
